business_quality_reasoning: Active Ltd since 2021, 4.9 stars across 72 Google reviews, claims 10+ years in the electrical industry with Napit, Part P and Trust Mark accreditations, and handles both domestic and commercial work across London — a real, established business with high-value jobs.
price_point_reasoning: Typical electrician call-outs run £80-150 for minor work, but the site lists EV chargers, full/part rewiring and EICR safety checks which sit in the £300-2,000 range; £600 is a fair midpoint job value.
modernity_gap: The site is a functional but dated template — red block sections, wavy edges, cramped mid-page copy — roughly 5-8 years behind current standards for trades sites.
site_weaknesses: Services listed as a dense bullet column with 'and more…' — no detail pages or pricing guidance per job type
Accreditations (Napit, Part P, Trust Mark) are buried as body text, not presented as visual trust badges
Only a single Google review is shown despite 72 reviews — most of the proof is invisible
Generic 'Welcome to…' copy takes up the largest content block without answering what a customer should do next
Gallery and Testimonials exist only as nav links — no visual proof of work on the homepage
No booking or quote form — conversion relies on a phone number and Gmail address in the header
site_analysis: The business has real substance — accreditations, a decade of experience, strong Google reviews — but the template presents none of it convincingly. Services are compressed into a bullet list, proof is thin (one review shown of 72), and the only paths to contact are a phone number and a personal Gmail address. It functions, but it undersells a genuinely credible operation.
review_summary: Your site covers the basics — your services, contact details and some background — but it hides the strongest parts of your business. Your Napit and Part P accreditations sit in a paragraph of text, and only one of your 72 Google reviews is visible. A clearer layout that leads with your credentials, shows your reviews properly and gives each service room would turn more of your visitors into calls.
outreach_angle: You've got Napit, Part P and Trust Mark accreditations and 72 Google reviews — but none of that is visible above the fold on your site, which is where most people decide whether to call.
